The '''Fakir sector''' was in the [[Bakchou arm]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Description==
The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included several hundred [[Planet/Legends|planets]] capable of sustaining life. Fifty of those planets developed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life, but only ten of those species achieved space-travel technology. [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers colonized around 150 other planets in the sector.<ref name="CP" />

Planets in the sector included [[Abonshee]], [[Alabash]], [[Iyuta]], [[Lorimax]], [[Mycroft]], [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]], [[Vakkar/Legends|Vakkar]], [[Doneer'so]], [[Flankers]], [[Halowan]], [[Sinkar]], and [[Fakir]] itself. The [[Sarnikken Asteroid Belt]] and the asteroid [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]] were also in the sector.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Sector was controlled by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power after the Clone Wars it established government headquarters on Doneer'so,<ref name="CP" /> and placed it under the rule of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lorin]].<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The sector was considered safe and stable, which led to most of the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet's]] forces being from the sector following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. While these forces fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the Rebels took the opportunity and inserted the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] [[The Irregulars|Irregulars]] to destabilize the sector. After several months, the Imperial [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] had to request an entire battle fleet as reinforcements.<ref name="CP" />

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], it was also the operation area of [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] saboteur [[Yansan]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]], [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], and [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] in the Fakir sector. Ando is in the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]]; Delaya is in the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]]; [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]] is in the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]]; Carida is in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]; [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] is in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]; Bimmisaari is in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]]; [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] is in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Additionally, the game mistakenly places the sector in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly places both the [[Hijoian Docks]] and the [[Ichalin Station]] in the Fakir sector instead of [[Hijoian Space/Legends|Hijoian Space]].
